discovery_notes: All claims from Disney Pins Blog search snippets (only publisher found covering ArtLand 2025-26; DPB Store is its own shop, so single-publisher, uncorroborated). Keys omit the retailer slug to match existing ArtLand keys; retailer recorded as a claim. Release year = month stated in post. Out-of-window leads seen: Signature Series (Ariel/Pocahontas, Jasmine/Rapunzel) Mar 2024; Alice Playing Card waves from Aug 2024 (later waves undated, may be 2025); Art Deco Jul 2022; Pixar Mystery 2021/2022; Zootopia Standing Together/On the Vine (blog says Jan 2021). Undated ArtLand titles needing a year check: Neo Nouveau princess, UP & Monsters Inc / Aladdin / Hunchback / Alice & Princess and the Frog Ben Harman, Moana Wayfinder & Maui, King Triton & Ariel Family Magic, BatB Oval 1 & 2, Gothic Princess, Princess & Horse, Dognapper Mickey, Belle & Jasmine / Merida & Tinker Bell swing, Peter Pan & Mermaid Lagoon, Pongo and Pugs, Protective Peg, Alex Hovey Robin Hood, Vasilovich dragon on glass, Jessica Rabbit LE300, Kim Possible, Roger Rabbit, Bruni/Flit/Hei Hei, Spider-Man/Infinity Conez/Sith Soda Marvel, Star Wars helmets (Vader/Death Trooper/Royal Guard), Cogsworth & Lumiere, Tea Party Reunion jumbo, Pinocchio & Jiminy glass, Fantasia Conducting Mickey. No ArtLand convention exclusives found.
